# neo4jaura_organization_users (Data Source)

Aura Organization Users.

-> **See also:** [Managing users in Aura](../guides/managing-users.md) for the end-to-end invite → import → manage flow. There is no dedicated "project users" data source — set `project_id` below to scope this data source to one project's members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "neo4jaura_organization_users" "this" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
}

# List only the members of a specific project.
data "neo4jaura_organization_users" "project_members" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  project_id      = var.project_id
}

variable "organization_id" {
  type = string
}

variable "project_id" {
  type = string
}

output "user_ids_by_email" {
  value = { for u in data.neo4jaura_organization_users.this.users : u.email => u.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization_id` (String) The ID of the organization the users are members of.

### Optional

- `include_projects` (Boolean) When true, fetches project membership. Defaults to `true`.
- `project_id` (String) When set, only users with membership in this project are returned.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the users data source.
- `users` (Attributes List) The list of users in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address of the user.
- `exempt_from_automatic_removal` (Boolean) Whether the user is exempt from automatic removal due to inactivity.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the user.
- `last_activity_at` (String) The timestamp of the user's last activity.
- `mfa_enrollment` (Attributes) The MFA enrollment details of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--mfa_enrollment))
- `organization_roles` (List of String) The user's roles within the organization. Possible values: `organization-admin`, `organization-member`, `organization-owner`.
- `projects` (Attributes List) The projects the user has access to within the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--projects))

<a id="nestedatt--users--mfa_enrollment"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.mfa_enrollment`

Read-Only:

- `methods` (Attributes List) The MFA methods the user has enrolled in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--mfa_enrollment--methods))
- `status` (String) The MFA enrollment status. Possible values: `enrolled`, `not_enrolled`, `external_auth_provider`, `non_applicable`.

<a id="nestedatt--users--mfa_enrollment--methods"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.mfa_enrollment.methods`

Read-Only:

- `enrolled_at` (String) The timestamp when the user enrolled in this MFA method.
- `id` (String) The MFA method identifier.



<a id="nestedatt--users--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.projects`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the project.
- `name` (String) The name of the project.
- `project_roles` (List of String) The user's roles within the project. Possible values: `project-admin`, `project-member`, `project-metrics-integration-reader`, `project-viewer`.
